text: G6 failed: right-padded B-row teacher forcing differs from batch-1 by up to 1.26 nats per 48-token program (bf16 batch-shape noise, above the 0.05-nat bound); q_lik and the fork margin are computed with batch-1 teacher forcing (exact per sequence, independent of batch composition)
Model weights live in the run's shared HF cache (HF_HUB_CACHE), not in a workspace hf_cache/ folder, per the run's storage rules; nothing to delete in the workspace.
The pod has one NVIDIA L4 (22.0 GiB usable, cc 8.9). bf16 fits (no FP8 anywhere); the memory probe chose B = 12 (peak 16.2 GiB, 5.9 GiB headroom).

vLLM base phase: the first engine start failed (instruct engine memory not yet released); the plan fallback (enforce_eager, max_model_len 1792, gpu_memory_utilization 0.97) was used. Longest prompt 289 tokens + 1024 new < 1792.

Optional iteration-5 files were not imported as modules: exp26's engine, context, sampling, prompt, sandbox, gate, judge and labeller code was PORTED into src/*6.py (copies of the sources in vendor/exp26/src with sha256 in vendor/SHA256SUMS); r_Q, templates, FORMAT_LINE, TEMPLATE_TAIL and the exp7 noun exclusions are the in-plan constants (identical to vendor/exp23/qwen_ratio.json and vendor/exp7/frozen/templates_nouns_padding.json). VENDOR_MISSING (not used): exp20 GTN hook, exp27 base-intent code, exp22 directions/, exp11 bench, exp8 suite, exp24 base rows, exp25 landings, exp18 known solutions.

GTN uses the teacher-forced shadow-row re-implementation stated in the plan (exp20's S3 hook not vendored); its hook hash (sha256 of src/engine6.py + src/ctx6.py, logged per row) differs from iteration 4. Matters only for cross-artifact GTN comparisons, never for L1 (events pooled within this artifact).

pool_l1.py and its synthetic tests were hash-committed in addendum 1 (before the first nudge row) rather than in commit #0; commit #0 froze its full specification verbatim (predictions/protocol_v6_panelI.json). The labeller/engine/instrument code was committed in the same addendum.

analysis/*.py (event builder, L2/L3/M/K, novelty, figures, outputs) and audit/*.py were written while the nudges ran and were exercised on partial nudge data for debugging; they implement the rules frozen in commit #0 and are hash-committed in addendum 2. The primary test (pool_l1.py) predates every nudge row.
Association prompts are rendered as in iteration 5: the task description followed by the association question (the FORMAT_LINE is omitted because the requested answer is one sentence).

BINT rows are generated on vLLM bf16 (unhooked, per-request seed) because every BINT slot has its own prompt (its own base intent) while the HF CRN engine batches one shared prompt; BINT is a knob only and never enters L1.

The HF unhooked forced top-up (up to 40 attempts) was not run: modes with fewer than 10 verified programs are flagged in units/<u>/forced_verified.json; q_lik uses the >= 3 available, and a mode with < 3 verified programs is undefined (uniform share).

S8 (15 existing tasks as SCREEN units, screen rescoring of the iteration-5 landings) NOT RUN: it needs the vendored bench labellers, the exp8 suite and exp24 base rows integrated into this pipeline, which did not fit the time left after the new-unit arms; the new-unit confirmation is unaffected (screen rows are never pooled).
S9 weight interpolation (first in the drop order) NOT RUN on time; K is reported without the interpolation baseline, a stated gap.
The optional S5(0) HF-base vs vLLM-base check was dropped on time (plan: optional, dropped on time).

Gate stage (i) build fixes before any gate (ii): runtime rules of I2 (sorted() on a range), I5 (two sorted generator inputs), I6 (two-pass loop threshold 1.3n), I10 (descending index runs) were corrected, and I2/I4/I5/I6/I8/I10 were rebuilt sequentially because 9 parallel builds inflated reference timings beyond 0.25 x the limit. No sampled program was looked at for these fixes.

Mid-labelling, a model program printed a '{...}' line that broke the sandbox protocol; user stdout now goes to /dev/null and sandbox records carry a marker prefix. Rows labelled before the fix were unaffected (the parse error only crashed the worker).

I10 failed gate (ii) (kappa 0.72); one revision round: runtime rule detects descending index runs (prefix-min/suffix-max arrays), AST fallback 'other' without a scan loop, a parameterless solve is invalid; all I10 rows were relabelled with the revised rules (old labels kept in data/labels_superseded_I10_gate1.jsonl) and the fresh holdout (base valid rows 10..19 + twin k 12, 13) passed (kappa 1.0, runtime vs adjudicated 1.0).
Cell shares: attempts = rows minus 'disputed'; 'invalid' rows count as failed attempts (so degenerate pushed cells fail the 0.8 x twin pass-rate gate); pass rate = passed / attempts.
Gate kappa: computed over traceable items (runtime label defined); when kappa is undefined because one label dominates, raw agreement >= 0.9 is required instead (iteration-5 convention).
Staged scaling on the first enrolled unit was run as 1 batch (12 rows) -> 8 batches (~100 rows) -> full, with results/timing_extrapolation.json written before the full run.

For throughput, raw rows were labelled by the runtime and AST labellers as soon as a unit's stage (i) build passed, before gate (ii); no label was used for any decision (default, forecasts, enrolment) before the unit's gate (ii) passed, and I10's rows were relabelled with its revised rules after the revision round.

L3 scores the forecasts against every correct nudged off-default program of the unit (ESC + PN + GTN, all cells), not only the pass-rate-gated cells that define landing events; units with fewer than 4 such programs have no L3 score.
I10's post-gate base audit ran after its revision round (after the nudges); it is QA only and enters no statistic.

analysis/novelty.py was amended after addendum 2 so that its judge calls are written to the cost ledger (results/costs.jsonl); the classification prompt and rules are unchanged. The amended file is a new chain entry (tag amendment_novelty_cost_logging); the addendum-2 entry therefore reports the file as changed in commit6.verify().
